g.text: OOAPI Reference Implementation - Persisted Database Schema (EF Core entities)
Generated from src/OEAPI.Infrastructure/Data/Entities/*.cs. An ER-diagram view of the actual
database, not the API contract (see api-model.puml for that). Solid arrows are foreign-key-
backed 1:N relationships; dashed arrows are many-to-many navigation collections (EF-managed
join tables, no explicit join entity in this codebase). Every entity except OtherCodeEntity
inherits Id/CreatedAt/ModifiedAt/IsActive from BaseEntity (an unmapped C# base class, not a
table - see the "Extensible enums"-adjacent note in docs/archive/DECISIONS-AND-ACTIONS.md for
why BaseEntity was extracted) and owns a 1:N OtherCodeEntity collection via IHasOtherCodes -
both omitted below as arrows to avoid ~40 near-duplicate lines; shown once, from BaseEntity/
OtherCodeEntity themselves. Regenerate via docs/diagrams/render.ps1 or render.sh after changing
Owned 1:N collection on every entity below
Each override entity owns its own independent
relationships - never shared with the parent
Course/Programme or with any other override entry.
